about: Pages whose shell code blocks run docker compose, npm, pnpm or yarn, with the repository and folder those commands run in. check-commands.mjs reads those files at one commit of the repository's default branch.

folder is where each code block starts, relative to the repository root. A cd to the repository's own name moves to the root. A cd to a relative folder inside the repository moves there if each folder on the way exists, and fails as missing if one does not or is a file. A cd through a link or a submodule, a cd with an unquoted * ? or [, and any other cd, makes the commands after it in that block blocked, because the check does not guess folders. The starting folder is checked the same way.
A page with one of these commands that is not listed here fails as not mapped.
